name: mods/alomare/flexible_stratagems
description: Bring the same stratagem more than once in the Hellpod loadout, vehicles included, and ready up with fewer than four. Set how many copies are allowed (2 to 4) with Mod Options Menu.
requires: Bingus Shared Loader v17 or newer
Mod Options Menu (optional: the copies setting)
Mod Bindings Menu (optional: the Clear Stratagems key)
